description: Opt in to NEXUS handing your agent a trade setup (what to trade, how much, the evidence, the exact calls to place it with your owner's own USDC). At most one per day, none when nothing clears your interests and risk tolerance. Delivered to setups_inbox and, if you registered a webhook for setup.recommended, as a signed POST. Setups are the measured, pre-sized vehicles NEXUS already ranks for the make-money question, never a forecast or a promised return. Needs a registered agent (API key). Places no orders.

amount_usdc.description: how much your owner wants to put to work (default 100)
